tei:div.tei:p: (ga)༄༅// 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs bcu gcig zhal dpal mo lugs kyi sgrub thabs rjes gnang dang bcas pa'i skor rnams bzhugs so// ༄༅// rgya gar skad du/ bhaṭṭa ra ka āryā ba lo ki te shwa ri ka da sha mu kha sya sā dha naṃ/ bod skad du/ rje btsun 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug zhal bcu gcig pa'i sgrub thabs/ btsun pa spyan ras gzigs la phyag 'tshal lo// lte ba zla bas rnam brgyan padma la// 'bar ba'i rgyan mnga' kun nas mun sel cing*// kha ba'i ri 'dra ri dwags lpags 'dzin pa// 'dzum bcas bzhugs la spyi bos btud byas te// 'gro ba de yi gnas thob 'dod pas 'dir// sgrub thabs cho ga bdag gis dran par bya// dang por re zhig gang yang rung ba'i yid dang rjes su mthun pa'i gnas legs par byugs par dri zhim po'i me tog kun tu gtor ba/ de'i dbus su stan bde ba la nye bar 'dug ste/ rang gi snying gar a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor rnam par bsam zhing*/ de'i steng du dro ba rnams kyi bzhi pa me'i bu la brten pa nga ro bzhi pas kun nas mnan zhing gzhon nu ma yi nu mas brgyan par blta'o// de nas sa bon gyi yi ge las 'od zer rnams byung bas bla ma dang sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ rje btsun spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug spyan drangs te/ de dag gi mdun nyid du phyag 'tshal ba sngon du song bas/ oṃ badzra arghaṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ badzra dhū pe āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ badzra puṣpe āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ badzra ā lo ke āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ badzra gandhe āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ badzra nai wi dya āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ badzra gī ti āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ zhes byin gyis brlabs pa'i mchod pa'i tshogs phul la/ gang yang bdag gis dus kun tu// sdig par bgyis pa gang gyur pa// skrag pas rmi 'drar 'chags bgyid cing*// deng nas brtsams te 'byung mi bgyid// dge ba rnams la rjes yi rang*// sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis gzung*// thams cad byang chub mchog tu bsngo// de thob lam la gnas bgyid cing*// dam pa'i skyabs la skyabs su mchi// de nas byams pa dang*/

snying rje dang*/ dga' ba dang*/ btang snyoms te tshangs pa'i gnas bzhi rim gyis mngon du byas la/ oṃ swa bhā wa bi shuddhaḥsarba dharmaḥswabhā wa shuddho3haṃ/ zhes brjod pas rgyu ba dang mi rgyu ba thams cad rang rang gi de bzhin nyid las mi 'da' bas rnam par dag par bsams te/ bdag kyang rnam par dag par bsams la/ yang*/ oṃ shū n+ya tā dzñā na badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3haṃ/ zhes brjod do// kun nas stong pa nyid du bdag nyid kyang bsam mo// de'i rjes la mdun du pam̐ las padma 'dab ma sna tshogs pa bsam zhing*/ de'i steng du a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor ro// de'i dbus su yang sa bon gyi yi ge de nyid do// de nas yang de las 'od zer byung ba rnams kyis 'gro ba rnams rnam par dag par byas nas 'ongs pa dang*/ de nyid la zhugs pas padma 'dab ma brgyad pa gser btso ma lta bur gyur par bsam par bya'o// de'i dbus su yang sa bon gyi yi ge de nyid do// de nas yang de las 'od zer lcags kyu lta bu dang*/ zhags pa lta bu byung bas sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams bkug ste/ bdag nyid dang gcig pas de la thim par blta'o// de ma thag tu padma sa bon dang bcas pa yongs su gyur pa las bdag nyid 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs zhal bcu gcig pa gangs ri'i rtse mo la nyi mas brgyan pa ltar dkar ba sku'i yan lag rgyan thams cad kyis spras pa nor bus spras pa'i gser mdog 'og pags can/ ras bzang pos sku'i smad g.yogs pa/ ri dwags kyi pags pas nu ma g.yon pa bkab pa/ ral pa dmar ser 'khyugs pas mdzes pa/ phyag gdub dang*/ zhabs gdub dang*/ rna cha gdub kor dang*/ mgul gdub dang*/ cod pan dang*/ dpung rgyan dang*/ dbu rgyan rtse phran gyis gsal bar byas pa/ 'od zer dkar pos kun nas bskor ba/ lang tsho la babs pa/ spyan dkyus ring zhing dpral ba yangs pa/ zhal bcu gcig pa/ rtsa ba'i zhal kun nas dkar ba/ g.yas pa ljang gu/

g.yon pa dmar ba/ zhal thams cad kun nas 'dzum pa'i nyams can/ de'i dbus ljang gu/ g.yas dmar po/ g.yon dkar po/ de'i dbus dmar po/ g.yas dkar po/ g.yon ljang gu'i bye brag rnams so// de'i steng du zhal rnam par gtsigs shing 'jigs pa/ nag po mche ba snang ba/ kun tu khros pa/ spyan gsum pa ral pa bsgreng ba'o// de'i spyi bor bandū ka'i me tog dang*/ byu ru bcag pa'i mtshams ltar gsal ba/ gtsug tor dang bcas pa/ rgyan spangs pa tshangs par spyod pa'i cha lugs can/ mgul pa dang bcas par byung ba/ zhi ba'i gzigs pas 'dzum pa'o// phyag gnyis thugs kar thal mo sbyar ba/ g.yas dang pos phreng ba 'dzin pa/ g.yon pa na gser gyi padma rtsa ba dang bcas pa 'dzin pa/ g.yas gsum pas yi dwags skom pa sel pa/ g.yon gsum pas ril ba spyi blugs 'dzin pa/ g.yas bzhi pas 'khor lo 'dzin pa/ g.yon bzhi pas mda' dang gzhu 'dzin pa/ lhag ma dgu brgya dgu bcu rtsa gnyis po rnams kyis mchog sbyin pa phyag padma'i 'dab ma ltar 'jam pa 'di lta bu rnam par bsam mo// de nas rang gi snying ga'i padma dang zla ba la gnas pa'i sa bon gyi yi ge gnas pa las byung ba'i 'od kyis btsun pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug spyan drangs te/ yang dag par mchod la bdag gi nang du bzhugs par bsam mo// de nas sku gsung thugs legs par gnas pas dbang bskur ba'i mthar thug par bsgrub bo// de'i rjes la rang gi snying gar padma dang zla ba la gnas pa'i sa bon kun nas dkar po 'od dang bcas pa mgo gyen du 'grengs pa bsams te/ de las byung ba'i sku rnams 'phros pas 'khor lo'i rnam par byung bar bsam zhing bsgom mo// gang gi tshe skyo ba na sa bon gyi yi ge yid la 'dzin pas nor bu'i mtshams su phyag 'tshal ba dang bcas pa'i mngon du gyur pa'i tshig spangs te/ oṃ dha ra dha ra/ dhi ri dhi ri/ dhu ru dhū ru/ iṭṭe baṭṭe/ tsa le tsa le/ pra tsa le pra tsa le/

ku su me ku su ma wa re/ i li mi li tsi ti dzwa la ma pa na ye swā hā/ zhes bya ba 'dod pa bzhin bzla'o// skyo bar gyur na ye shes sems dpa' mdun du bzhugs pa la mchod do// gsol ba gdab pa dang*/ bzod par gsol ba dang*/ gshegs par mkhyen par bya ba'i phyir dza hi zhes lan gsum brjod do// langs nas mchod bstod la sogs pa bya'o// 'dir gang dag de snyed kyi phyag rgya dag dmigs par mi nus pas phyag brgyad pa'am/ zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa'am/zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa yang bsam zhing phyag gnyis pa padma dang mchog sbyin par blta'o// sgrub thabs cho ga bkod pa yi// dge ba gang zhig dri med ni// bdag gis bsags des 'gro ba kun// srid mtsho'i pha rol 'gro bar shog /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug zhal bcu gcig pa'i sgrub thabs/ dge slong ma dpal mos mdzad pa rdzogs so// rgya gar gyi mkhan po dāe paṃ ka ra shrī dzñā na dang*/ lo tsā ba rin chen bzang pos bsgyur ba'o// ༈ /'jig rten dbang phyug gi gzhung bzhi nyams su len tshul bzhugs so// yang dag lam ston dge ba'i bshes gnyen dang*// thugs rje'i gter chen spyan ras gzigs mgon la// rnyog med dang ba'i yid kyis phyag 'tshal nas// rmad byung gnad kyi gdams pa 'di bshad bya// de la 'dir yang dag pa'i sgrub pa la brtson pas/ sa dang po'i rtogs pa brnyes pa dge slong ma dpal mos o rgyan gyi yul gyi rgyud rgyas pa las phyung nas sdig pa bshags pa'i cho ga dang*/ bya rgyud kyi khongs su gtogs pa phyag stong spyan stong pa'i gzungs dang*/ zhal bcu gcig pa'i gzungs la sogs pa rnams la brten nas zhal bcu gcig pa'i sgrub thabs/ gtor ma'i cho ga bstod pa ste/ spyan ras gzigs la brten pa'i gzhung bzhi mdzad pa'i don nyams su len pa la/ sdig pa bshags pa'i cho ga nyams su len pa'i tshul dang*/ gzhung phyi ma gsum nyams su len pa'i tshul te gnyis las/

dang po la bzhi ste/ rten gyi gang zag dus kyi khyad par/ cho ga'i khyad par/ dka' thub kyi khyad par ro// dang po la/ tha mal pa sdig po che dang*/ thugs rje chen po la yi dam byed pa dang*/ gsang sngags gzhan nyams su len pa dang gsum las/ dang pos ni tha mal pa'i gzugs dang*/ gnyis pas ni thugs rje chen po'i nga rgyal dang*/ gsum pas ni yi dam gyi lha gang yin pa'i nga rgyal gyis bshags pa byed do// gnyis pa ni/ zla ba gang yang rung ba'i tshes bdun nas dgu'i bar ram/ bcu bzhi nas bcu drug bar ram/ nyi shu nas tshes gcig gi bar te nyin zhag dgu ni bshags pa'i dus yin la/ zhag re re la'ang brtson ba'i bye brag gis thun gsum mam bzhi'am/ lnga'am drug tu bya'o// gsum pa ni/ gnas dben par skyang nul la sogs pa byas nas maṇḍal khru gang pa la/ ba'i rnam lnga'am/ dri bzang gi chus byugs te/ me tog dkar po sil ma dgram/ ces pa tsam las mi 'byung yang*/ dmigs pa gsal ba'i ched du dbus dang g.yas g.yon gnyis mdun rnams su me tog gi tshom bu bzhi bya'o// de'i mtha' skor du mchod pa rnam pa lnga ci 'byor pa bsham mo// de nas/ maṇḍal gyi steng du paṃ las sna tshogs padma'i lte bar a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su hrīḥdakar po de las 'od zer phar 'phros sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las lha gsum thod pa dang bzhi cig car du bskyed de/ dbus su thugs rje chen po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa g.yas mchog sbyin/ g.yon padma'i sdong bu bsnams pa/ sku mdog gser dang 'dra ba/ 'jam pa/ snum pa/ dbu rgyan du 'od dpag med bzhugs pa/ g.yon na sgrol ma zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma sku mdog ljang gu/ g.yon na utpal 'dzin pa rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ g.yas phyogs su sbrul dkar po 'khyil nas zhal nam mkha' la gdangs pa/ mdun na thod pa dkar po me tog sna tshogs kyis bkang ba'o// thugs rje chen po'i thugs kar ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du thod pa dkar po'i nang hrīḥ'i mtha' mar gzungs kyi yi ges bskor ba/

rang gi snying gar yang de bzhin bsgoms la/ sngar byas kyi sdig pa la 'gyod pa drag po dang*/ phyin chad mi byed pa'i sdom sems bskyed de/ rang gi lus kyang mang por sprul/ sems can thams cad kyis kyang sdig pa bshags par bsams la/ thugs rje chen po'i thugs ka'i yi ge rnams las 'od zer shangs bug g.yas nas byung*/ rang gi g.yon nas zhugs te yig 'bru la thim par bsam zhing gzungs ring gcig gis thog drangs pa'i gzungs thung bdun nam nyer gcig gam/ brgya rtsa brgyad la sogs pa nus tshad bzla/ mjug dge ba'i rtsa ba byang chub tu bsngo/ bzhi pa ni/ mtshams med pa la sogs pa'i sdig pa byas na/ dngos gzhi'i dus su smyung gnas bya/ zla ba nya gsum la smyung bar byas nas/ bcu drug gi nyi ma rtse shar la bza'/ rtsa ba'i ltung ba byung ba la ni zas dkar gsum bza' zhing zhag gsum bzla/ yang na zas gcig pa zhag gsum bya'o// sbom po yan chad la sha chang spangs pa tsam gyis bya'o// khyad par du sngags pa'i sdig pa bshags na mdun gyi thod pa'i me tog yid kyis bsal la/ rang gi rnam smin gyi lus po der bcug ste 'khyags pa zhu ba ltar bdud rtsir gyur par bsam/ de nas rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams spyan drangs la rje btsun ma sgrol mas phyag tshad byas nas sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams la drang bar bsam mo// de ltar gang zag bzhi las/ dang po ni/ tha mal pa sdig po che dang*/ bar pa gnyis ni/ pha rol tu phyin pa'i lugs kyi byang chub tu sems bskyed pa dang*/ tha ma ni/ sngags kyi sgor zhugs pa'i dbang du byas so// gnyis pa ni/ 'di'i rjes su gnang ba thob pa'i gang zag gis stan bde ba la 'dug ste/ skyabs su 'gro ba dang sems bskyed pa sngon du song nas/ rang skad cig gis thugs rje chen po bcu gcig zhal du gsal ba'i snying gar a las zla ba'i steng du yi ge hrīḥdakar po de las 'od zer lcags kyu'i rnam pa lta bu dpag tu med pa 'phros pas/

bla ma dang*/ sangs rgyas dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ rje btsun spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug spyan drangs par bsams la/ sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku// rdo rje 'dzin pa'i ngo bo nyid// dkon mchog gsum gyi rtsa ba ste// bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// chos sku nam mkha' bzhin du dbyer med kyang*// gzugs sku 'ja' tshon bzhin du so sor gsal// thabs dang shes rab mchog la mnga' brnyes pa'i// rigs lnga bde bar gshegs la phyag 'tshal lo// dus gsum bde bar gshegs pa chos kyi sku// 'gro drug sems can rnams la spyan ras gzigs// nam mkha' lta bur khyab pa'i bcu gcig zhal// gzi brjid 'od dpag med la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes pas phyag bya/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ārya a wa lo ke shwa ra sa pa ri wā ra oṃ badzra puṣpe āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ badzra dhū pe āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ badzra dī paṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ badzra gandhe āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ badzra nai wi dya āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ zhes pas mchod pa 'bul lo// de nas/ gang yang bdag gis dus kun du// sdig pa bgyis pa gang gyur pa// skrag pas rmi 'drar 'chags bgyid cing*// deng nas brtsams te 'byung mi bgyid// dge ba rnams la rjes yi rang*// sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis gzung*// thams cad byang chub mchog tu bsngo// de thob lam la gnas bgyid cing*// skyabs gsum la ni bdag skyabs mchi// zhes lan gsum brjod la/ de nas tshad med pa bzhi bsgoms nas/ oṃ swa bhā wa bi shuddhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shuddho3haṃ/ zhes pas rgyu ba dang mi rgyu ba thams cad rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag par bsam/ oṃ shū n+ya tā dzñān badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3haṃ/ zhes pas thams cad stong pa nyid du bsams nas/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las sna tshogs padma 'dab ma brgyad pa/ de'i lte bar a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hrīḥdakar po/

de las 'od zer 'phros pas sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs nas spyan ras gzigs kyi go 'phang la bkod/ tshur 'dus de nyid la zhugs pas padma 'dab ma brgyad pa gser btso ma lta bur 'bar ba/ lte bar hrīḥyig gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer lcags kyu dang zhags pa lta bu dpag tu med pa spros/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bkug nas hrīḥl thim/ de ma thag tu padma hrīḥdang bcas pa yongs su gyur pa las/ bdag nyid 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug bzhengs pa sku mdog dkar po lang tsho dar la bab cing 'od zer 'phro ba/ zhal bcu gcig pa'i rtsa zhal dkar ba/ g.yas ljang ba/ g.yon dmar ba/ de'i steng ma dbus ljang*/ g.yas dmar/ g.yon dkar ba/ de'i steng du dbus dmar ba/ g.yas dkar ba/ g.yon ljang ba/ de rnams 'dzum pa'i nyams can/ de'i steng na khro zhal nag po mche ba gtsigs shing khro gnyer dang ldan pa/ spyan gsum pa/ ral pa dmar ser gyen la bsgreng ba/ de'i spyi bor zhi zhal dmar po gtsug tor dang bcas pa/ rgyan spangs pa/ tshangs par spyod pa'i cha lugs 'dzin zhing 'dzum pa mgul pa dang bcas pa'o// phyag dang po gnyis thugs kar thal mo sbyar ba/ g.yas gnyis pas bgrang phreng*/ gsum pa mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya las bdud rtsi'i rgyun 'dzag pas yi dwags kyi bkres skom sel ba/ bzhi pas 'khor lo 'dzin pa/ g.yon gyi gnyis pa na gser gyi padma yu ba dang bcas pa/ gsum pa ril ba spyi blugs/ bzhi pa na mda' gzhu 'dzin pa/ phyag lhag ma dgu brgya dang dgu bcu rtsa gnyis padma'i 'dab ma ltar 'jam zhing mchog sbyin mdzad pa/ phyag thams cad kyi mthil na spyan re re yod pa/ phyag rnams yar dbu'i gtsug tor dang*/ mar pus mo'i lha nga las mi 'da' ba/ ri dwags kyi pags pas nu ma g.yon pa bkab pa/ ras bzang po'i sham thabs can/ nor bus spras pa'i gser gyi ska rags dang ldan pa/ ral pa dmar ser 'khyug pas mdzes pa/

rin po che'i dbu rgyan/ rna rgyan/ mgul rgyan/ phyag gdub/ zhabs gdub/ dpung rgyan/ dar gyi cod pan la sogs pas brgyan cing*/ 'od zer dkar po 'phro bar bsam/ de'i thugs kar pad zla'i steng du hrīḥdakar po de las 'od zer 'phros pas 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug spyan drangs/ mchod pa lngas mchod nas dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes pas gnyis su med par bstim mo// rang gi dpral bar zla ba'i steng du oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po rnams sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs su mos par bya'o// slar yang snying ga'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas 'od dpag med kyis gtsor byas pa'i rigs lnga mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs nas mchod pa lngas mchod de/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni// lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar// lha yi chu ni dag pa yis// de bzhin bdag gis sku khrus gsol// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shri ye hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing byang chub sems kyi chu rgyun gyis dbang bskur bas lus thams cad gang*/ dri ma thams cad dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las 'od dpag med gtso bor gyur pa'i rigs rnam pa lngas dbur brgyan/ rang gi snying gar padma dang zla ba'i steng du rang 'dra'i ye shes sems dpa' tshon gang ba/ de'i thugs kar padma dang zla ba'i steng du ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' hrīḥdakar po de las thugs rje chen po'i sku dpag tu med pa 'phros/ sems can gyi sdig sgrib sbyangs nas thugs rje chen po'i go 'phang la bkod/ tshur 'dus hrīḥl thim par yun ring du bsam mo// bsgoms pas skyo na/ sa bon gyi mthar sngags kyi phreng ba g.yas skor du bkod la spro bsdu snga ma bzhin du bsam ste/

na mo ratna tra yā ya/ na ma ārya dzñā na sā ga ra bai ro tsa na byu ha rā dzā ya/ ta thā ga tā ya/ arha te samya ksaṃ buddha ya/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bhyaḥ arha ddhyaḥ samya ksaṃ buddhe bhyaḥ na ma ārya a wa lo ki te shwa rā ya/ bo dhi satwā ya/ mahā satwa ya/ mahā kā ru ṇi kā ya/ tadya thā/ oṃ dha ra dha ra/ dhi ri dhi ri/ dhu ru dhū ru/ iṭṭe/ baṭṭe/ tsa le tsa le/ pra tsa le/ pra tsa le/ ku su me/ ku su ma ba re/ i li mi li/ tsi ti dzwa la ma pa na ye swā hā/ zhes gzungs ring tshar gcig gis sna drangs pa'i snying po ci nus bzla/ slar yang mdo 'dzin gyi rtsar slebs pa'i tshe gzungs ring re res sna drangs par bya'o// mjug tu ye shes pa mdun du phyung ba la mchod pa lngas mchod/ gsol ba btab/ nongs pa bzod par gsol te/ dza hi zhes lan gsum brjod nas gshegs su gsol te/ rang dam tshig pa'i nga rgyal gyis gnas par bya'o// thun mtshams su 'byung po thams cad la gtor ma sbyin par 'dod na/ rin po che la sogs pa'i snod du dkar gtor bshams te/ swa bhā ba'i sngags kyis stong par sbyangs nas/ stong pa'i ngang las yam̐ las rlung*/ bam̐ las chu/ lam̐ las sa'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du pam̐ las padma dang*/ bhrūm̐ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/ kham̐ las kha zas ro brgya dang ldan pa nam mkha' dang mnyam par dmigs la/ rang nyid dam tshig sems dpa'i ngo bor gnas pa'i snying ga'i sa bon gyi 'od zer gyis phyogs bcu'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi bkug nas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum brjod pas de la bstim par bya'o// de nas nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags dang phyag rgyas mi zad par spel nas/ yang snying ga'i sa bon gyi 'od zer gyis/ brgya byin la sogs pa'i phyogs skyong rnams kyis mtshon pa'i 'byung po rnams bkug cing*/ spyan ras gzigs kyi ngo bor byas te/ ljags la hrīḥs mtshan pa'i 'od kyi sbu gus gya nom pa'i zhal zas de dag drangs nas gsol bar bsams la/

oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā ṇāṃ ādya nutpan na twātā oṃ āḥhūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes lan gsum brjod la gzhan yang*/ phyogs bcu kun na bzhugs pa yi// lha klu gnod sbyin dri za dang*// mi'am lto 'phye mkha' lding dang*// yi dwags sha za grul bum sogs// 'byung po'i tshogs kun 'dir byon la// legs sbyar zas 'di bzhes nas kyang*// mi mthun rkyen las byung ba yi// bar chad thams cad zhi ba dang*// tshe dang bsod nams 'phel ba dang*// 'dod pa'i don kun 'grub par mdzod// ces zang zing gi dngos po byin la/ chos kyi sbyin pa ni/ ye dharma he tu pra bha wā he tunte ṣānta thā ga to hya ba data/ te ṣāñtsa yo ni ro dha e wa bā dhi mahā shra ma ṇaḥ zhes brjod par bya'o// bstod pa yang thun mtshams su mdun du thugs rje chen po mngon sum ltar dmigs nas bstod pa yin gyi/ sngar gyi cho ga'i yan lag tu sbyar ba ni mi snang ngo*// de ltar na bshags pa'i cho ga ni/ lam du ma zhugs pa'i tha mal pa dang*/ bya rgyud rang lugs ltar nyams su len pa dang*/ rgyud sde gong ma ltar nyams su len pa thams cad la sbyar du rung la/ sgrub pa'i thabs ni/ rnal 'byor rgyud kyi lugs ltar mdzad pa ste/ bdag nyid spyan ras gzigs yan lag bzhi rdzogs su bskyed nas/ cho ga tshar ba'i tshe ye shes pa gshegs nas dam tshig pa rkyang pa'i nga rgyal gyis gnas par bshad pa'i phyir ro// nyams su len pa'i tshul yang tha mal pa sdig po che yin na/ sngar gyi bshags pa'i cho ga sdig pa dag pa'i mtshan ma byung byung gi bar du nyams su blangs nas de'i 'og tu 'di'i rjes su gnang ba zhus te sgom bzlas la 'jug cing*/ gzhan dag gis ni dang po nyid nas rjes gnang zhus te sgom bzlas la 'jug pa'i dbang du byas pa yin gyi/ gzhung 'dis smyung gnas kyi dus kyi bdag bskyed bstan pa ni gtan ma yin te/ smyung gnas ni bya rgyud kyi lugs yin la/

bya rgyud la bdag bskyed med par ye shes rdo rje kun las btus su bshad cing*/ rgyud sde rang nyid nas kyang bdag bskyed ma bshad la don thob la'ang med pa'i phyir dang*/ gzhung las kyang mtshams med byas pa la sogs pas kyang bshags pa'i cho ga byed pa'i tshe nyi ma bar pa la zas mi bza' ba kho na la smyung gnas su bshad kyi gzhan rnams la ni smyung gnas kyi tha snyad byas pa'ang mi snang ba'i phyir/ de'i tshe sang nangs par tho rangs zas bza' ba'ang mi 'thad de/ bshags pa'i gzhung las/ bcu drug gi nyi ma rtse shar la bza' zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro// bya rgyud kyi lha la bdag bskyed sbyar ba ni/ rgyud sde gong ma'i cho ga ltar nyams su len pa yin la/ de'i tshe lus sdug bsngal ba'i ched du smyung gnas byed pa mi 'thad de/ gsang 'dus rtsa rgyud las/ dka' thub dka' spyad mi bzad pas// bsgrubs na 'grub par mi 'gyur zhing*// zhes sogs mang du gsungs la/ de dag gi don bsdus nas/ dpal ldan sa skya paṇḍi tas/ bya ba'i rgyud la bdag bskyed med// bris sku mchod nas dngos grub len// bdag bskyed sgrub thabs yod pa ni// rnal 'byor rgyud kyi rjes 'brangs nas// de yi lugs bzhin mdzad pa yin// de ltar byed na smyung gnas med// bdag nyid lha ru bskyed pa la// mchod na bsod nams brnyes na sdig /zhes sogs gsungs so// 'on kyang lus sdug bsngal ba'i ched du ma yin par de bzhin gshegs pas gsungs pa'i cho ga rnam par dag pa yin pas nyams su blang bar bya'o// snyam pa'i bsam pas ni rgyud sde gong ma'i rnal 'byor pas kyang nyams su blang du rung bar rje btsun gyis gsungs so// bod kyi smyung gnas pa dag gis bdag nyid thugs rje chen po bcu gcig zhal yan lag bzhi rdzogs su bskyed/ mdun du maṇḍal la rdul tshon gyis padma 'dab brgyad dang*/ bum pa dang gtor ma gsum bshams nas/ maṇḍal la dbus su zhal bcu gcig pa/

phyogs bzhir mi bskyod pa/ rin 'byung*/ rnam snang*/ don grub rnams yan lag bzhi rdzogs su bskyed nas bdag bskyed dang mdun bskyed kyi phyag nas bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas bum pa gang bar bsam zhing gzungs bzla/ mjug tu bdag bskyed kyi ye shes pa mdun bskyed la bstims nas po bstod mang du 'don/ bum pa'i chus dang por mdun bskyed la khrus gsol nas phyis rang nyid la khrus byed pa ni sngar gyi gzhung bzhi po de dag gi dngos bstan gyi don du mi snang yang*/ lugs 'di la brten nas dngos grub brnyes pa mang du byung 'dug pas brgyud pa'i man ngag gam dge slong ma dpal mo'i gzhung gzhan la brten par snang ngo*// rgyud dang rgya gar 'phags ma'i gzhung bzhin du// sdig pa bshags dang sgom bzlas gtor ma dang*// bstod pa'i tshogs rnams nyams su len tshul te// 'jig rten mgon po'i gzhung bzhi bdag gis bshad// rnam dag dge tshogs kunda'i phreng ba ltar// rnam par dkar ba gang zhig thob pa des// rnam mang 'gro ba srid pa'i mtshor lhungs rnams// rnam mkhyen chos kyi rgyal po'i gnas thob shog /dge slong ma dpal mos mdzad pa'i thugs rje chen po'i gzhung bzhi nyams su len pa'i tshul 'di ni rgyud sde bzhi'i lam gyi babs dang mthun par gzhung bzhi'i dgongs pa ji lta ba bzhin du/ shes bya'i dkyil 'khor mtha' dag la bsnyengs pa mi mnga' ba'i mkhyen rab can chos kyi rgyal po kun dga' bzang po yab sras kyi gsung la brten nas/ rgyal khams pa bsod nams seng ges gling kha bde ba can du sbyar ba'o// ༈ /'phags pa zhal bcu gcig pa'i sgrub thabs rjes gnang dang bcas pa bzhugs so// na mo lo ke shwa rā ya/ 'di'i rjes su gnang ba thob pa'i gang zag gis stan bde ba la 'dug ste/ skyabs su 'gro ba dang sems bskyed sngon du song nas/ rang skad cig gis thugs rje chen po bcu gcig zhal du gsal ba'i snying gar a las zla ba'i steng du yi ge hrīḥdakar po/

de las 'od zer lcags kyu'i rnam pa lta bu dpag tu med pa 'phros pas/ bla ma dang sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dang rje btsun spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug spyan drangs par bsams la/ sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku// rdo rje 'dzin pa'i ngo bo nyid// dkon mchog gsum gyi rtsa ba ste// bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// chos sku nam mkha' bzhin du dbyer med kyang*// gzugs sku 'ja' tshon bzhin du so sor gsal// thabs dang shes rab mchog la mnga' brnyes pa'i// rigs lnga bde bar gshegs la phyag 'tshal lo// dus gsum bde bar gshegs pa chos kyi sku// 'gro drug sems can rnams la spyan ras gzigs// nam mkha' lta bur khyab pa'i bcu gcig zhal// gzi brjid 'od dpag med la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes pas phyag bya/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ārya a wa lo ki shwa ra sa pa ri wā ra oṃ badzra puṣpe āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ badzra dhū pe āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ badzra dī pe āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ badzra gandhe āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ badzra nai wi dya āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ zhes pas mchod/ gang yang bdag gis dus kun tu// sdig pa bgyis pa gang gyur pa// skrag pas rmi 'drar 'chags bgyid cing*// deng nas brtsams te 'byung mi bgyid// dge ba rnams la rjes yi rang*// sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis gzung*// thams cad byang chub mchog tu bsngo// de thob lam la gnas bgyid cing*// skyabs gsum la ni bdag skyabs mchi// zhes lan gsum brjod/ tshad med bzhi bsgoms la/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs nas haṃ/ zhes pas rgyu ba dang mi rgyu ba thams cad rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag par bsam/ oṃ shū n+ya tā dzñā na badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3haṃ/ zhes pas de thams cad stong pa nyid du bsams la/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las sna tshogs padma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hrīḥdakar po de las 'od zer 'phros pas sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/

spyan ras gzigs kyi go 'phang la bkod/ tshur 'dus de nyid la zhugs pas padma 'dab ma brgyad pa gser btso ma lta bur 'bar ba/ lte bar hrīḥyig gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer lcags kyu dang zhags pa lta bu dpag tu med pa spros/ sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bkug nas hrīḥl thim/ de ma thag tu padma hrīḥdang bcas pa yongs su gyur pa las/ bdag nyid 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug bzhengs pa sku mdog dkar po lang tsho dar la bab cing 'od zer 'phro ba/ zhal bcu gcig pa'i rtsa zhal dkar ba/ g.yas zhal ljang ba/ g.yon zhal dmar ba/ de'i steng ma gsum dbus ljang*/ g.yas dmar/ g.yon dkar ba/ de'i steng ma gsum dbus dmar/ g.yas dkar/ g.yon ljang ba/ de rnams 'dzum pa'i nyams can/ de'i steng na khro zhal nag po mche ba gtsigs shing khro gnyer dang ldan pa/ spyan gsum/ ral pa dmar ser gyen la bsgreng ba/ de'i spyi bor zhi zhal dmar po gtsug tor dang bcas shing rgyan spangs pa/ tshangs par spyod pa'i cha lugs 'dzin zhing 'dzum pa mgul pa dang bcas pa'o// phyag dang po gnyis thugs kar thal mo sbyar ba/ g.yas kyi gnyis pas bgrang phreng*/ gsum pa mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya las bdud rtsi'i rgyun 'bebs pas yi dwags kyi bkres skom sel ba/ bzhi pas 'khor lo 'dzin pa/ g.yon gyi gnyis pas gser gyi padma yu ba dang bcas pa/ gsum pas ril ba spyi blugs/ bzhi pas mda' gzhu 'dzin pa/ phyag lhag ma dgu brgya dang dgu bcu rtsa gnyis padma'i 'dab ma ltar 'jam zhing mchog sbyin mdzad pa/ phyag thams cad kyi mthil na spyan re re yod pa/ phyag rnams yar dbu'i gtsug tor dang*/ mar pus mo'i lha nga las mi 'da' ba/ ri dwags kyi pags pas nu ma g.yon pa bkab pa/ ras bzang po'i sham thabs can/ nor bus spras pa'i gser gyi ska rags dang ldan pa/ ral pa dmar ser 'khyug pas mdzes shing*/ rin po che'i dbu rgyan/ rna rgyan/ mgul rgyan/ phyag gdub/

zhabs gdub/ dpung rgyan/ dar gyi cod pan la sogs pas brgyan cing*/ 'od zer dkar po 'phro bar bsam/ de'i thugs kar pad zla'i steng du hrīḥdakar po/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug spyan drangs/ mchod pa lngas mchod nas/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥzhes pas gnyis su med par bstims la/ rang gi dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po rnams sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs su mos pa byas/ slar yang snying ga'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas 'od dpag med kyis gtsor byas pa'i rigs lnga mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs la/ mchod pa lngas mchod/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni// lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar// lha yi chu ni dag pa yis// de bzhin bdag gis sku khrus gsol// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shri ye hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing byang chub sems kyi chu rgyun gyis dbang bskur bas lus thams cad gang*/ dri ma thams cad dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las 'od dpag med gtso bor gyur ba'i rigs rnam pa lngas dbur brgyan/ rang gi snying gar padma dang zla ba'i steng du rang 'dra'i ye shes sems dpa' tshon gang pa/ de'i thugs kar padma dang zla ba'i steng du ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' hrīḥdakar po/ de las thugs rje chen po'i sku dpag tu med pa 'phros/ sems can gyi sdig sgrib sbyangs nas thugs rje chen po'i go 'phang la bkod/ tshur 'dus hrīḥl thim par yun ring du bsam mo// bsgoms pas skyo na/ sa bon gyi mthar sngags kyi phreng ba g.yas skor du bkod la spro bsdu snga ma bzhin du bsams te/ na mo ratna tra yā ya/ na ma ārya dzñā na sā ga ra bai ro tsa na bhū ha rā dzā ya/ ta thā ga tā ya/

arha te samyaksaṃ buddhā ya/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bhyaḥ.arhaddhyaḥ samyaksaṃ buddhe bhyaḥ na maḥ.ārya a wa lo ki te shwa rā ya/ bo dhi satwā ya/ mahā sa twā ya/ mahā kā ra ṇi kā ya/ tadya thā/ oṃ dha ra dha ra/ dhi ri dhi ri/ dhu ru dhu ru/ iṭṭe baṭṭe/ tsa le tsa le/ pra tsa le pra tsa le/ ku su me ku su ma ba re/ i li mi li/ tsi ti dzwa la ma pa na ye swā hā/ zhes gzungs ring tshar gcig gis sna drangs pa'i snying po ci nus bzla/ slar yang mdo 'dzin gyi rtsar slebs pa'i tshe gzungs ring re res sna drangs par bya'o// mjug tu ye shes pa mdun du phyung pa la mchod pa lngas mchod gsol ba btab/ nongs pa bzod par gsol la/ dza hi zhes lan gsum brjod nas/ gshegs su gsol te/ rang dam tshig pa'i nga rgyal gyis gnas par bya'o// thun mtshams su 'byung po thams cad la gtor ma sbyin par 'dod na/ rin po che la sogs pa'i snod du dkar gtor bshams te/ swa bhā wa'i sngags kyis stong par sbyangs nas/ stong pa'i ngang las yaṃ las rlung*/ pam̐ las chu/ yam̐ las sa'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du pam̐ las padma dang*/ bhrūm̐ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/ kham̐ las kha zas ro brgya dang ldan pa nam mkha' dang mnyam par dmigs la/ rang nyid dam tshig sems dpa'i ngo bor gnas pa'i snying ga'i sa bon gyi 'od zer gyis phyogs bcu'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi bkug nas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum brjod pas de la thim par bsam/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags dang phyag rgyas mi zad par spel/ snying ga'i sa bon gyi 'od zer gyis brgya byin la sogs pa'i phyogs skyong rnams kyis gtsor byas pa'i 'byung po rnams bkug ste/ spyan ras gzigs kyi ngo bor gyur par bsam/ ljags la hrīḥs mtshan pa'i 'od kyi spu gus gya nom pa'i zhal zas de dag drangs nas gsol bar bsam zhing*/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā ṇāṃ ādya nutpanna twātā oṃ āḥhūm̐ phaṭaḥswā hā/

zhes lan gsum brjod la/ phyogs bcu kun na bzhugs pa yi// lha klu gnod sbyin dri za dang*// mi'am lto 'phye mkha' lding dang*// yi dwags sha za grul bum sogs// 'byung po'i tshogs kun 'dir byon la// legs sbyar zas 'di bzhes nas kyang*// mi mthun rkyen las byung ba yi// bar chad thams cad zhi ba dang*// tshe dang bsod nams 'phel ba dang*// 'dod pa'i don kun 'grub par mdzod// ces zang zing gi dngos po byin la/ chos kyi sbyin pa ni/ ye dharmā he tu pra bha wā he tunte ṣānta thā ga to hya ba data/ teṣāñtsa yo ni ro dha e waṃ bā dī mahā shra ma ṇaḥ zhes brjod do// rjes gnang byed na/ mchod pa byin gyis brlabs la/ bdag bskyed gong bzhin bya/ tshom bu lhar bskyed/ mchod bstod gtor ma a kā ro'i sngags kyis phul te bzlas pa bya/ slob mas maṇḍal phul/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad dang*// sogs dang*/ gur nas 'byung ba'i rgyun bshags bya/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo dpal ldan bla ma dam pas bdag la 'phags pa 'jig rten dbang phyug zhal bcu gcig pa'i sku gsung thugs kyi rjes su gnang ba stsal du gsol/ zhes pa rnams lan gsum gsum dang*/ gzhi 'god pa'i phyir slob ma bskyed bstim bya/ rjes su bzlas pa lan gsum dang*/ bcom ldan 'di la sogs brjod/ dam bca' ba spyi dang mthun/ byin gyis brlab pa'i phyir rigs 'dra bstim/ gtso bos sogs 'dra/ rjes mchod bstod byas la ye shes pa gshegs su gsol/ dam tshig pa bsdus la bkra shis bya'o// zhes pa 'di don du gnyer ba 'ga' la phan pa'i phyir du shākya'i dge slong dkon mchog lhun grub kyis sbyar ba'o// ༈ /thugs rje chen po bcu gcig zhal gyi bsnyen thabs dri med phreng ba bzhugs// na ma ārya lo ke shwa rā ya/ dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi mkhyen brtse'i gzugs// gangs can mgon po rje btsun spyan ras gzigs// nyam thag 'gro ba'i skyabs gcig khyod mchod nas// bsnyen sgrub lag len tho yig 'dir spel lo// 'di la don gsum ste/

rten gyi gang zag des ji ltar nyams su blang ba'i tshul/ phan yon bstan pa'o/ dang po ni/ 'di'i rjes su gnang ba thob cing dam tshig dang ldan pa khyad par snying rjes rgyud brlan pa'i gang zag go /gnyis pa ni/ bcu gcig zhal dpal mo lugs kyi bsnyen sgrub la/ dben pa'i gnas su mtshams kyi bcad rgya bya zhing thugs rje chen po'i sku bris 'bur la sogs rten gang 'byor gyi mdun du/ gtor ma gcig gam spro na smyung chog chen mo ltar 'das gtor nas bgegs gtor gyi bar du bshams kyang rung*/ chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i mchod pa sogs yo byad thams cad tshang bar bya/ grub na gso sbyong blang*/ de ma byung na'ang sha chang sgog btsong sogs spangs shing gtsang sbra la gnas pa gal che/ thugs dam dngos ni/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed nas ye shes pa gshegs su gsol ba'i bar grub nas/ rang dam tshig pa'i nga rgyal gyis snga thun gyi mtshams 'byung po thams cad pa'i gtor ma btang ba sogs dkon mchog lhun grub pa'i sgrub thabs ltar bya/ gang ltar yang gnas gsum bsrung ba dang bsngo smon spyi ltar bya'o// gtor ma rgyas pa la mos na smyung chog ltar rung mod/ 'dir snga ma ltar legs so// bsnyen pa'i grangs ni snying po

tadyathā zhes pa man/ 'bum phrag drug smyung bar gnas pa lan bdun 'id sgrub bsnyen te zhag nyer gcig go/ thugs rje chen po yid bzhin 'khor lo'i gzungs stong phrag gcig phar phyin drug dang*/ sa bcu pa dang*/ sgo mtha' yas pa'i gzungs rnams kyang ci rigs pa 'don no// zhes gsungs pa'i thugs rje chen po yid bzhin 'khor lo'i gzungs la 'gyur khyad mang du 'dug na'ang 'dir bkod pa bka' btsan pa'i dbang du byas pa 'di lta ste/ na mo ratna tra yā ya/ na ma ārya a wa lo ki te shwa rā ya/ bo dhi sa twā ya/ mahā satwā ya/ mahā kā ru ṇi kā ya/ tadyathā/ oṃ tsakra brti tsintā ma ṇi mahā padme ru ru tiṣṭha te/ dzwa la ā karṣa ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ yid bzhin 'khor lo'i gzungs rdzogs so// lo tsā ba rin chen bzang po'i bsgyur ces bya ba thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston chos 'byung na 'dug de ni rtsa ba'i sngags so/ oṃ padma tsintā ma ṇi dzwa la dzwa la hūm̐/ snying po'o// oṃ war ta padma ni hūm̐ phaṭa/ nye ba'i snying po'o// oṃ ma ṇi badzrī ṇi hūm̐/ snying po'o// sngags phyi ma rnams ni ji ltar rigs pa bzla/ ༈ /phar phyin drug ni gzungs ni/ rgyud 'bum gyi spyan ras gzigs kyi skor gyi glegs bam du 'byung ba 'di lta ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ 'di ni gzungs bod skad du bsgyur ba ste ngag 'don yin no/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal lo// oṃ a mo gha bā sha mahā dā na pā ra mi tā pā ri pū rā ya hūm̐/ da ra da ra/ pi bi dha/ tsi tsi tī/ sarba satwāḥ u pa bho ga sarba ta thā ga ta mahā dā na/ pū dza me gha/ pra brta ya/ ta ra ta ra/ tā ra ya/ tā ra ya/ mahā padma pā ṇi hūm̐ phaṭa/ 'di ni sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'i zhags pa chen po'i snying po ste/ gang gis yungs 'bru tsam gyi sbyin pa byin te dran pa tsam gyis lan bdun bzlas brjod byas na mchod sbyin sbyin pa rnam par 'phrul pa chen po shin tu rgyas pa chen po'i pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro// de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo// byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug thugs rje chen po la phyag 'tshal lo// oṃ a mo gha shī la sambha ra sambha ra/

bha ra bha ra/ mahā shuddha satwa padma bi bhū ṣi ta/ bhu dza dha ra dha ra sa manta a wa lo ki te hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ gzungs 'dis smyung bar gnas te gso sbyong gi yan lag brgyad bzung nas mi smra bar lan nyi shu rtsa gcig dran par bya'o// de nas a mo gha pā sha'i snying po bzlas brjod bya'o// bzlas brjod byas pa tsam gyi mod la tshul khrims yongs su dag pa chen po dang ldan par 'gyur ro// tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro// tshul khrims kyi dri zhim po'i dri mang po lus las 'byung zhing phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten du grags par 'gyur ro// gang gis nyi ma re re zhing dran pa de ni rtag tu tshul khrims yongs su dag par 'gyur ro// dge slong gang zhig tshul khrimasanyams pas smyung bar gnas te 'di bzlas brjod byas na bzlas brjod byas pa'i mod la tshul khrims yongs su dag par 'gyur zhing*/ tshul khrims mang po dang ldan par 'gyur ro// de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo// byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug thugs rje chen po la phyag 'tshal lo// oṃ a mo gha kṣānti/ sarba bo dhi satwa kṣa mi ṇi/ kṣa ṇa kṣa ṇa/ mahā mai trī kā ru ṇi ka sarba satwa pat+sa la/ mahā kā ru ṇi ka sarba satwa kṣa mi ṇi hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ gzungs 'dis sems can du gyur pa thams cad la bzod pa chen po dang brtse ba'i sems kyis dmyal bar gnas pa dang*/ byol song gi skye gnas su gtogs pa dang*/ ri dwags dang*/ bya gang dag 'das pa gang yin pa dang*/ gnas pa gang yin pa dang*/ skye ba gang yin pa de rnams la snying rje'i phyir gang zhig gis gzungs kyi tshig dran par byed na dmyal ba'i sems can las thar bar 'gyur zhing skye bo mang po gnas gang yin pa rnams grol bar 'gyur ro// nam sangs rgyas kyi zhing la gnas kyi bar du bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro// de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo// byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug thugs rje chen po la phyag 'tshal lo// oṃ mahā bīrya a mo gha bi lo ki te ba ra ba ra dṛ ḍha bīrya/

mahā ba la/ pa la ba la/ ma hā bo dhyaṃ ga ba la bo dha ni hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ gzungs 'di dus rtag tu yongs su dag pa'i yid kyis dran par byas na dran pa tsam la sogs pa'i mod la brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su dag par 'gyur ro// byang chub kyi snying po la thug gi bar du nam yang brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang 'bral bar mi 'gyur ro// de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo// byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug thugs rje chen po la phyag 'tshal lo// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta mahā a mo gha kā ru ṇa/ dhya na sa mā dhi/ sarba bi mo kṣa/ a pra kamya ka tsu ru tsu ru hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ gzungs 'di 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la dmigs nas yid rtse gcig tu byas te dran par byas na dran pa tsam gyi mod la bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro// gzhan yang ting nge 'dzin stong phrag brgya so sor thob par 'gyur ro// bzlas brjod byas pa tsam gyis ting nge 'dzin thams cad dbang du 'gyur ro// de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo// byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug thugs rje chen po la phyag 'tshal lo// oṃ a mo gha mahā pradzñā pā ra mi tā a ba bhā sa sa manta spha ra ṇa bu dhi/ pra sa ra pra sa ra/ sa manta bu dhi/ a wa lo ki te bha ga wān/ pradzñā a wa lo ki te tsakṣuṣāṃ mahā pradzñā pa ra ma ṇi mahā pradzñā/ padma dhā ri ṇi bhū dzaṃ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ gzungs 'di dran pa tsam gyi mod la shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro// thabs dang shes rab kyi dge ba chen po'i blo 'phel bar 'gyur ro// rtag tu shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bcu'i blo dang ldan par 'gyur ro// phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang*/

'das pa dang ma 'ongs pa dang da ltar byung ba'i sangs rgyas rjes su dran pa'i shes rab dang blor 'gyur ro// lan 'ga' yang pha rol tu phyin pa drug dang 'bral bar mi 'gyur ro// don yod zhags pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa drug gi gzungs chen po rdzogs so// pha rol tu phyin pa drug po'i gzungs 'di gang zhig sems bskyed pa gcig gis bzlas na dge ba'i rtsa ba bskal pa gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed kyi bar du byas pa dang bsod nams mnyam mo// de bas lung blangs pa gcig gis sems bskyed nas 'di brjod na sngar gyi des phan yon bye ba stong gi char yang mi phod pa 'di gdams ngag che'o zhes 'byung ngo*// ༈ /sa bcu pa'i gzungs ni/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo// oṃ/1 oṃ bhuḥ2 oṃ padme/3 oṃ padme hrīḥ4 oṃ padma bhu dze/5 oṃ padma a wa lo ki te/6 oṃ padma dzwa la hūm̐ dhrika7 oṃ a mo gha ma ṇi padme/8 oṃ padmo la tsa ni hu ru hūm̐/9 oṃ padmo ṣa ṣṇī bi ma le hūm̐ phaṭa/10 sa bcu pa'i gzungs rdzogs so// 'di stong phrag bzlas pas sa so so thob pa'i thun mong ma yin pa'i rgyur 'gyur ba'o// zhes so// ༈ /na mo ratna tra yā ya/ tadyathā/ oṃ a ṇe mahā ra ṇe/ a khe mu khe mu khe/ sa manta mu khe/ sau me sa/ sauryā ra me/ sau ti yu ga me/ ni rukte/ naṃ rukte/ pra bhe/ hi li hi li/ kalpa kalpa/ si sā re/ sā ra ba ti/ hi le hi le/ hi le hi le/ hi le hi le/ hi le hi le/ hi hi le/ mahā hi hi le/ hi le tuṇḍe/ tsaṇḍe tsa ba ṇe/ tsa ra tsa ra ṇi/ a tsa le/ ma tsa le/ a nante/ a nanta mu khe/ a naṅga te/ a ra ṇe/ nirma ma ḍe/ nirwa pa ni/ nirbarta ni/ ni dhā na te/ dharma dhā re/ ni hā re/ ni hā ra/ bi ma le/ bi sho dha ne/ shī la bi sho dha ni/ pra kṛ ti dī pa ne/ bha ba ni bha ba/ bi bhā ba ne/ a saṅge a saṅge/ bihā re/ dha me sha me/ bi ma le/ bi ma la pra bhe/

saṃ karṣā ṇi/ dhi ri dhi dhi re/ mahā dhi dhi re/ ya sho ya sho ba ti/ tsa le a tsa le/ ma tsa le/ sam̐ tsa le/ tri dha sandhi/ su sthe re/ a saṅge/ a saṅge bi hā re/ a saṅga ni ra hā re/ ni hā ra/ bi ma le/ ni hā ra/ bi sho dha ne/ tri dhā so me/ sthi ra sthi me/ sthī ma ba ti/ mahā pra bhe/ sa manta pra bhe/ bi ma la pra bhe/ bi pū la rasmi/ saṃ bha we/ sa manta mu khe/ sarba tra a nu ga te/ ā nā tshe dya pra ti bha ne/ dhā ra ṇī ni dhā ni/ dharmā ni dhā ni go tri/ sa manta bha dre/ sarba ta thā ga ta a dhi ṣṭha na a dhi ṣṭhi te swā hā/ 'di bris pa dang sgrogs pas po ta la'i sgo 'byed/ sgo mtha' yas pa'i gzungs so// de rnams ni grangs bsnyen yin la/ gsum pa phan yon ni/ zhal bcu gcig pa'i gzungs las/ gzungs 'di lan gcig bzlas pas kyang*/ nyan thos kyi rtsa ba'i ltung ba bzhi po dag kyang byang bar 'gyur la/ mtshams ma mchis pa lnga po dag kyang ma lus par 'byang bar 'gyur na/ ji skad bshad pa bzhin du nan tan bgyid na lta smos kyang ci 'tshal/ de dag gis ni sangs rgyas bye ba khrag khrig 'bum phrag du ma la dge ba'i rtsa ba bskyed par 'gyur ba lags na/ bzlas brjod bgyis pa dang*/ bsgrubs pas lta smos kyang ci dgos te/ bsam pa thams cad yid bzhin du rdzogs par bgyi'o zhes gsungs pa dang*/ smyung gnas lan gcig gis kyang bskal pa bzhi khrir 'khor ba phyir bsnyil bar 'gyur te/ gzungs de nyid las/ su zhig bdag gi slad du/ tshes bcu bzhi'am/ bco lnga smyung bar gnas par bgyis na/ des bskal pa bzhi khri'i 'khor ba phyir bsnyil bar 'gyur ba lags/ bcom ldan 'das bdag gi ming 'dzin pa ni don che ste/ sangs rgyas bye ba phrag 'bum gyi pas kyang lhag lags so// zhes gsungs pa dang*/ gzhan yang lung las skye ba dman pa bud med kyis kyang smyung bar gnas pa lan gcig byas pa na/ shi 'phos na byang chub sems dpa' skyes pa'i lus can thob nas 'khor ba la rgyab kyis phyogs par 'gyur ba dang*/

dud 'gro pho 'chi ba'i tshe gzungs 'di lan gcig bzlas nas rna bar btab na nges par bde ba can du skye ba dang*/ dud 'gro mo 'chi ba'i tshe gzungs 'di rna bar btab na/ mi'i 'jig rten du skye ba'i lus blangs nas/ byang chub kyi sems kyi bag chags 'jog par gsungs la/ de bzhin du lus smyung bar gnas pas lus kyi sgrib pa 'dag ngag smra ba bcad pas ngag gi sgrib pa 'dag gzungs yid kyis bzlas pas yid kyi sgrib pa 'dag des na 'di lta bu'i chos nyams su len pa la brtson par bya zhing*/ dal 'byor thob pa don yod par bya bar 'dod na/ bla ma mtshan nyid dang ldan pa la/ 'di'i rjes gnang rnam par dag pa zhus nas sgom bzlas tshul bzhin du bya ste/ nyin re bzhin gzungs brgya rtsa re ma chag par brjod na/ phan yon bsam gyis mi khyab ste/ gzungs de nyid las/ nangs par langs nas brgya rtsa brgyad bton na/ tshe 'di nyid la yon tan bcu yongs su 'dzin par 'gyur te/ bcu gang zhe na/ rtag par lus la bro nad ma mchis par 'gyur ba dang*/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis yongs su gzung bar 'gyur ba dang*/ des bsgrim mi 'tshal bar nor dang 'bru dang dbyig rnams rnyed par 'gyur pa dang*/ dgra thams cad khugs shing thul par 'gyur ba dang*/ rgyal po'i tshogs rnams gsong por smra bar sems par 'gyur ba dang*/ lus la dug gis mi tshugs pa dang*/ dbyig dug gis mi tshugs pa dang*/ rims kyis mi tshugs par 'gyur ba dang*/ mtshon chas mi tshugs par 'gyur ba dang*/ chab kyis 'gum pa'i dus bgyid par mi 'gyur ba dang*/ zhugs kyis 'gum pa'i dus bgyid par mi 'gyur ba dang*/ dus ma lags pas 'gum pa'i dus bgyid par mi 'gyur ba lags so// gzhan yang yon tan bzhi yongs su 'dzin par 'gyur te/ de'ang 'gum pa'i tshe de bzhin gshegs pa mthong bar 'gyur ba dang*/ ngan song rnams su skye bar mi 'gyur ba dang*/ ya nga ba ma spangs par 'gum pa'i dus bgyid par mi 'gyur ba dang*/

'di nas shi 'phos nas kyang 'jig rten gyi khams bde ba can du skye bar 'gyur ba lags so// zhes spyan ras gzigs nyid kyis gsungs so// gzhan yang smyung bar gnas par byed pa'i sbyin bdag byas te/ smyung gnas kyi las pa byed pa rnams kyang bsod nams shin tu che ste/ smyung gnas byas pa'i nangs par snga dro de la bshos drangs na/ sa brgyad pa la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' la drangs pa dang bsod nams mnyam pa dang*/ gso sbyong blangs pa tsam la drangs na dgra bcom pa la drangs pa dang bsod nams mnyam pas/ des na sbyin pa'i bdag po de yang ngan song du mi skye zhing byang chub kyi sems dang ldan par 'gyur ba dang*/ skye ba thams cad du mi zad pa'i gter dang phrad cing*/ sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su rdzogs par gsungs la/ de dang mthun par byang chub sems dpa' chu bzang pa chen po'i zhal chems las kyang*/ nga rang gi brgyags lhag ma gang 'dug rnams dge rtsa gzhan bya mi dgos kyi smyung gnas la 'tshogs pa'i mi rnams la 'byor na gdan non re gyis/ de ma 'byor na thug pa re drongs/ de yang ma 'byor na tsha dang 'o ma re thob/ de yang ma 'byor na me shing gi ka ru ma re gyis/ 'phags pas nga la mngon sum du lung bstan pa yin gyis bsod nams dpag tu med pa yong gsungs/ 'phags pa khong rdzun mi gsung gi mi'i zer lo yin lo la ma nyan/ nga rang la dge rtsa gzhan mi dgos kyi/ ma jo chos skyid kyis smyung gnas pa rnams la gdan non mang du byas pas/ mo shi ba'i dus dur khrod du rus pa bskyal bas/ bya rog gis rus pa khyer byung ba ring bsrel du song ba 'di mthong ngam gsungs so// de la sogs pa phan yon bsam gyis mi khyab/ des na sangs rgyas kyis gsungs pa'i chos la mi zab pa cung zad med cing*/ gsang sngags bla med kyi lam ni ches zab na'ang*/ nyams su len pa'i gang zag dbang po rnon po 'khor ba las blo log pa/

las rgyu 'bras la phra zhing phra ba nas 'dzem pa/ sems can thams cad drin can gyi pha mar shes nas de'i ched du rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang thob pa la ches rings pa'i gang zag la rnal 'byor bla med kyi lam ston pa yin la/ de las gzhan pa la nyes par 'gyur dogs kyang yod mod/ chos 'di ni gang zag dbang po rab 'bring tha gsum gyis nyams su blangs pas phan yon chen po dang ldan pa zhig ste/ byang chub sems dpa' zla ba rgyal mtshan gyi zhal nas/ dam pa'i chos 'di ni mthong ba dang*/ thos pa dang*/ reg pa dang*/ sgor zhugs pa thams cad ngan song las grol ba'i rgyu byed par 'dug phyag stong spyan stong gi sgrub thabs 'di ni sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi sgrub thabs yin pas/ thams cad kyis 'di la bslab par bya'o zhes gsungs pas/ snying rje chen pos kun nas blangs te sems can thams cad la chos 'di ston gang thub bya ste/ de yang 'di'i grangs bsnyen dang*/ sgrub bsnyen tshad du 'khyol ba'i gang zag gis chos 'di gzhan la bstan na phan yon bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig ste/ bsnyen pa 'khyol ba tsam gyis/ mi de ri mthon po'i rtser phyin na des mthong ba'i sems can thams cad ngan song du mi skye/ des chu las brgal na chu de la gnas pa'i sems can thams cad dang*/ chu de 'thung ba thams cad kyang ngan song du mi skye/ de'i grib ma phog pa dang*/ lus la reg pa dang*/ mig gis mthong ba rnams kyang ngan song du mi skye bar gsungs na/ des chos bstan na phan yon chen po 'byung ba lta smos kyang ci dgos/ des na mdo las/ 'jig rten gyi khams rin po che sna bdun gyis bkang nas dkon mchog gsum la mchod pa phul ba bas kyang*/ sangs rgyas kyi chos tshig bzhi pa gcig sems can la bstan pa bsod nams che ba sogs chos bshad pa'i phan yon rnams kyang dran par byas nas/ 'di lta bu'i chos zab mo sems can la ston pa la brtson pa mi lhod par bya'o// don zhags cho ga zhib mo sogs// dri med gsung rab chu gter las// bsnyen thabs nor bu'i phreng blangs pas// don gnyis dpal gyis 'byor gyur cig
